name: Interactive Globe
summary: A canvas globe that flies in to highlighted countries or regions, with satellite imagery, focusable markers and a liquid glass popover per marker.
useWhen: Showing a handful of places on a world map with details on click
Introducing a country or region with a zoom-in from the whole globe
Travel, office or event locations where geography is the story
avoidWhen: Street-level maps, routing or many hundreds of points
Measured values per country, where analytics/geo-01 to geo-04 fit better
Exact boundary work: borders are Natural Earth 1:110m
